A '''blacklance''' is a black-scaled snake approximately seven feet long. Blacklances are as quick as lightning and very poisonous. This breed of snake is solitary and won't attack unless it means to feed... or is provoked.{{ref/book|11|25}}

{{Quote|A strange man, who lets poisonous serpents go. From the fellow's reaction, I assume a blacklance ''is'' poisonous?"<br />"Very. But snakes don't bite anything they can't eat unless they're threatened."<br />"You may kiss me, Toy.|[[Tuon]] & [[Mat]]}}
